name: Altbaumer
summary: Old Black Forest 4-player partnership trick game where teams race to win 3 of 5 tricks using two permanent Club matadors.
rules_text: 4 players in fixed partnerships sit opposite, 24-card pack (A K Q J 10 9). Qc=Big Tree and Jc=Little Tree are top trumps always. Deal 5 cards each in 3+2, 4 cards stock. Forehand and partner are makers. Dealer turns stock cards one by one: forehand may take first suit as trump discarding one to stock, otherwise successive cards until different suit appears which becomes trump automatically. If all 4 same suit that suit is trump and forehand takes all 4 discarding 4. Follow suit if able else must trump, no need to head. Special: if non-trump Club led, Trees count as Clubs and may be played as Clubs; if you have no ordinary Clubs you must play a Tree if able. Highest trump or highest led suit wins. Makers need 3 tricks; 3-4 tricks = +1, 5 tricks = +2 to makers; if makers fail defenders score. First to 5 points wins round.
rating_reason: Trick-taking trump game with hidden hands, clear strategy.
